status: Prospective proposals written after numerical review; no archaeological tests performed.

tests.claim: Additional delivery beyond a specified baseline is necessary.
tests.required_observations: Independently fix the occupation interval, minimum delivered demand and full-horizon upper baseline output in commensurable units, including imports, substitutes and other flows.
tests.rejection_observation: Observed continued delivery exceeds the entire allowed supply envelope without the proposed mechanism.
tests.scope_of_rejection: Reject the particular bounded historical reconstruction and investigate omitted sources or measurement/law error; conservation itself does not name the missing source.
tests.remaining_limit: A proposed local requirement disappears when baseline outside or initial supply covers demand.

tests.claim: A proposed set of replacement operations jointly fits available time and resources.
tests.required_observations: Independent task duration, resource/skill bounds and overlapping dated deadlines, with declared uncertainty intervals.
tests.rejection_observation: No joint schedule exists for any admissible reconstruction while relevant service continuity is independently attested.
tests.remaining_limit: Finding separate feasible task plans cannot rescue joint infeasibility.

tests.claim: Instantaneous repair or last-period training enabled continuation.
tests.required_observations: Repair completion times, permitted interruptions and teacher/learner overlap established independently.
tests.rejection_observation: Completion follows the permitted service interruption or knowledge transfer takes longer than the available overlap.
tests.remaining_limit: A different recovery tolerance or recruitment route remains possible.

tests.claim: The selected service was sustained locally without sufficient imported delivery.
tests.required_observations: Independent provenance, delivered quantities and redistribution across a frozen boundary, distinguishing final services from complementary inputs.
tests.rejection_observation: Outside usable deliveries suffice to close the deficit.
tests.remaining_limit: Regional interdependence remains compatible; unknown imports leave necessity unresolved.

tests.claim: Technical feasibility suffices for enacted renewal, or a single central controller is necessary.
tests.required_observations: Observe rights, communication, task assignment and incentives/enforcement while allowing distributed institutions.
tests.rejection_observation: Feasible work remains unperformed under conflict, or successful provision occurs through autonomous coordinated actors.
tests.scope_of_rejection: Reject feasibility-alone sufficiency or the centralized-controller requirement, respectively.
tests.remaining_limit: The finite model establishes neither organizational mechanism.

tests.claim: Aggregate delivery implies the stated minimum for every selected resident.
tests.required_observations: Resident-level access evidence and a preregistered population/service minimum.
tests.rejection_observation: Aggregate service persists while members of the selected population remain excluded below the minimum.
tests.remaining_limit: A narrower aggregate persistence outcome may still hold.

tests.claim: The measured renewal capacity supplies explanatory information about later service continuity.
tests.required_observations: Use one sampling frame with short- and long-lived settlements, frozen capacity coding, consistent duration definitions, uncertainty and censoring.
tests.rejection_observation: The prespecified predictor fails to distinguish subsequent documented continuity from failure under the comparison design.
tests.scope_of_rejection: Weaken or reject that predictor and model specification.
tests.remaining_limit: This is not a rejection of accounting necessity or proof of causation from prediction.

tests.claim: The baseline restoration margin guarantees survival under the declared disturbance support.
tests.required_observations: Independently estimate losses to newly renewed assets and available recovery time; declare support without assigning unsupported rates.
tests.rejection_observation: A supported event removes every available restored route before continuation is allowed.
tests.scope_of_rejection: Reject unconditional robustness under the baseline law.
tests.remaining_limit: A favorable realized history can still support a separate possibility claim.
